sanskrit_verse: अभक्ष्येण द्विजं दूष्यो दण्ड्य उत्तमसाहसम् । मध्यमं क्षत्रियं वैश्यं प्रथमं शूद्रमर्धिकम् ॥२.२९६॥
transliteration: abhakṣyeṇa dvijaṃ dūṣyo daṇḍya uttamasāhasam / madhyamaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ prathamaṃ śūdram ardhikam // YajñS_2.296
sph_interpretive_translation: One who defiles a twice-born through prohibited food shall incur liability equivalent to highest outrage; for Kshatriya, middle-level offense; for Vaishya, initial level; for Shudra, half measure.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Liability scales according to varna-based spiritual capacity.
Causation: Defilement via prohibited food disrupts ontological purity.
Capacity-based responsibility: Higher varnas bear greater dharmic sensitivity.
Restoration logic: Realigning consciousness through proportional completion.
Consciousness alignment: Each varna's dharma determines karmic resonance.
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor consumes prohibited substance AND causes defilement of dvija THEN assign uttamasāhasa-liability END
IF actor is Kshatriya THEN apply madhyama-grade corrective protocol END
IF actor is Vaishya THEN apply prathama-grade correction END
IF actor is Shudra THEN apply ardhika proportion of base correction END
NO punitive escalation beyond consciousness-realization threshold
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, varna-specific dharmic sensitivity determines the nature of restorative engagement. The Court must align corrective measures with the individual’s innate spiritual capacity rather than impose uniform penalties.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that ingestion of impure substances disrupts sequential spiritual manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ). Liability is assigned based on causal clarity and proportional awareness, ensuring no punitive overlay distorts dharma’s restorative function.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate purification process aligned with offender’s varna-dharmic structure.
Assign completion ritual to restore energetic congruence with violated principle.
Engage guru-guided sādhanā to realign consciousness with purity codes.
Reintegrate into societal dharma through witnessed vow of non-recurrence.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism as Source-Authority: Dharma restored through consciousness-aligned enforcement. No punishment arises—only completion. Reality remains non-retaliatory. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
